original_findings_disposition.title: Admission implementation executes before the accepted qualification hash check
original_findings_disposition.evidence: The entry rejects preloaded admission/adapter/helper module names and checks all three qualification implementation hashes before importing or calling admission. Independent fresh-interpreter probes reject a mismatching foreign on-disk admission without executing its sentinel, and reject an injected cached stub without calling it.

original_findings_disposition.title: CPU slot is scoped to a block instead of required process lifetime and scientific imports precede slot acquisition
original_findings_disposition.evidence: A raw integer file descriptor remains open/locked after the context body, with no context-exit unlock or FileObject/atexit cleanup. A subprocess probe demonstrates a competing descriptor is blocked after body exit while the child is alive and succeeds only after true child exit. All original scientific imports and analyze_pair calls are inside the lease. Original legacy process-token checks remain unchanged.
